title: Off-grid house for the Darlington Point block
must: liveable year-round in Riverina heat and frost
runs off-grid: power, water and wastewater on site
prefer: shed home or similar low-cost build
cheapest total cost to move in, not cheapest kit
notes: Cheapest decent option wins. Always compare the landed, move-in cost: house, freight, slab, labour, fit-out, approvals, plus the off-grid and site works every option needs.

crew.title: Crew housing: team members on rotation
must: under $100,000 all-in upfront, ready to move in
decent standard: aircon and heating, insulated, proper kitchen and bathroom, secure
suits people staying days to weeks at a time, on rotation
prefer: low running cost per year when half-empty
on the block or within 30 minutes of it
crew.notes: Separate from the family house. Compare upfront all-in cost and yearly running cost; buying, renting, second-hand transportables and park or motel stays all count.
